_comment: Local-stack suites that do NOT carry the TW4A_LOCAL_URL gate (they talk to the database container directly) and are therefore invisible to the TW4A_LOCAL_URL grep that `matrix` uses. `matrix` runs each one on its own fresh stack with the environment listed here. In `env`, {DB} is replaced by the stack's database container name. `marker` creates the tw4_local_qa_only marker table on that stack (the same as ISO_QA_MARKER=1). `matrix` refuses (incomplete, exit 4) when a localStack.*.test.ts file at the tested ref carries neither the TW4A_LOCAL_URL gate nor an entry here, so a new suite can never be silently left out. Listing a suite here only makes it run; its result is judged like any other (a skip is exit 4, never green). urlSuiteOptions: per-suite options for TW4A_LOCAL_URL-gated suites (marker only); the marker is opt-in because it changes what fake-provider paths accept, so it is never on for suites that do not need it.

src/lib/sms/twilioIsv/__tests__/localSta._note: its first beforeAll assertion requires the tw4_local_qa_only marker table; without it the whole suite fails (the old BLOCKED-by-harness state)
